name: Follow the Queen
description: Follow the Queen is one of the most unpredictable and chaotic variations of Seven Card Stud. While it follows the standard Stud structure, it introduces a roving wild card mechanic that can change mid-hand. The core rule is that Queens are wild, and the rank of the card dealt immediately after a Queen (the 'Trailer') also becomes wild. This creates massive hand rankings where Five-of-a-Kind is not just possible, but frequent, and the lead can shift dramatically with a single card deal.

content.text: Follow the Queen is one of the most unpredictable and chaotic variations of Seven Card Stud. While it follows the standard Stud structure, it introduces a roving wild card mechanic that can change mid-hand. The core rule is that Queens are wild, and the rank of the card dealt immediately after a Queen (the 'Trailer') also becomes wild. This creates massive hand rankings where Five-of-a-Kind is not just possible, but frequent, and the lead can shift dramatically with a single card deal.

A popular home game variant from the mid-20th century, Follow the Queen was designed to inject high volatility into the otherwise methodical game of Seven Card Stud. It is a staple of 'Dealer's Choice' poker nights across North America.
Standard Seven Card Stud deal: 2 down, 4 up, 1 down.
